In today’s fast-paced world, time is everything. Whether you're managing a growing business or simply staying on top of your coverage, accessing your insurance information should be simple, secure, and available on your schedule—not ours.

That’s why we created our **Client Portal**, a streamlined, 24/7 hub designed to put you in control of your insurance needs.

### What Is the Client Portal?

Our client portal is your all-in-one digital insurance dashboard. It gives you direct access to critical tools, documents, and contact information—so you can take action when you need to, without the back-and-forth.

Whether you’re requesting a certificate or checking on a claim, the portal is built to make your insurance experience more efficient and transparent.

### Key Features You’ll Love

-   **Instant Auto ID Cards**  
      
    Generate and download your auto ID cards whenever you need them.
-   **Certificate Requests**  
      
    Request certificates of insurance with just a few clicks—no phone calls required.
-   **Policy Access**  
      
    View all your current insurance policies in one secure place.
-   **Know Your Team**  
      
    See who your broker and account manager are, with direct contact information.
-   **Claims Overview**  
      
    Track your claims in real-time and never wonder where things stand.
-   **Document Library**  
      
    Quickly access important documents like endorsements, renewals, and policies—all safely stored in your portal.

### How Your Business Benefits

-   **24/7 Self-Service**  
      
    Log in anytime. No waiting for business hours or callbacks.
-   **Faster Turnaround Times**  
      
    Requests get processed faster when everything starts digitally.
-   **Improved Transparency**  
      
    You’ll always know where your coverage stands and who to contact.
-   **Better Communication**  
      
    Streamlined access to your team means quicker answers and fewer delays.

### It’s Easy to Get Started

If you haven’t activated your portal access yet, there’s no better time. Contact us at **(800) 378-5554** or visit [**uwibrisk.com**](/) and we’ll walk you through everything you need to get started.
